metadata.name: openGym
metadata.description: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker. It plans workouts, logs sets, and signs you in with passkeys. The web container proxies the API and serves exercise media.
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: NGINX_PORT
environment_variables.description: Port nginx listens on inside the web container.

environment_variables.name: BACKEND
environment_variables.description: API service name that /api is proxied to.

environment_variables.name: PORT
environment_variables.description: Port the API listens on. The web container proxies to the same value.

environment_variables.name: RESOLVER
environment_variables.description: Docker embedded DNS used by nginx.

environment_variables.name: CF_CONNECTING_IP
environment_variables.description: Empty drops CF-Connecting-IP so a direct client cannot forge the logged address.

environment_variables.name: BASE_PATH
environment_variables.description: Empty serves the app at the site root.

environment_variables.name: MEDIA_UPLOAD_MAX
environment_variables.description: Largest upload nginx passes to the API.

environment_variables.name: DATA_DIR
environment_variables.description: Accounts, passkeys, session secret, and uploads.

environment_variables.name: TRUST_PROXY
environment_variables.description: Trust forwarded headers from the web container, which overwrites them.

environment_variables.name: ORIGIN
environment_variables.description: Full URL the app is served from. Must match the published host port.

environment_variables.name: RP_NAME
environment_variables.description: Name shown in the passkey prompt.

volumes.description: Accounts, passkeys, per-user state, and the session secret
Optional AI Coach provider credential cache
Exercise images downloaded on first start
Exercise animations downloaded on first start
Same exercise-image volume, written by the one-shot media service
Same exercise-animation volume, written by the one-shot media service

ports.description: Web UI. Official host port is 8080, which is already published by other apps.

before_install.en_us: Open http://localhost:20808 and create a profile with a passkey. Passkeys work on localhost over HTTP. Any other hostname needs HTTPS plus matching RP_ID and ORIGIN. The first start downloads about 140 MB of exercise media. Host port 8080 was already in use, so this listing publishes 20808.
